2014_spells.continual-flame.description: A flame, equivalent in brightness to a torch, springs forth from an object that you touch. The effect looks like a regular flame, but it creates no heat and doesn't use oxygen. A continual flame can be covered or hidden but not smothered or quenched.
2014_spells.continual-flame.effectSummar: Create a magical effect at a point you choose
2014_spells.continual-flame.fullDescript: Using 1 action, a flame, equivalent in brightness to a torch, springs forth from an object that you touch. The effect looks like a regular flame, but it creates no heat and doesn't use oxygen; A continual flame can be covered or hidden but not smothered or quenched. The effect lasts for until dispelled.
